description: An Epic coordinates; it does not implement. The node set contains no IMPLEMENTATION stage, which is how 'do not turn an Epic into one enormous linear workflow' is enforced structurally rather than advised: an Orchestrator that would prefer a single linear run has no expressible way to ask for it. VALIDATION is present for the Epic's own outcome and not for its children's: DEFINITION_OF_DONE section 7 requires that outcome to be evaluated against its own profile with evidence, and the Validator is the only role that supplies an outcome verdict. It is non-mutating, so the Epic still never touches code. There is no REWORK stage, so a REJECTED verdict on an Epic's outcome has no edge and becomes BLOCKED - which is right: an Epic whose children all shipped and whose outcome nobody can demonstrate is a decision for a human, not a lap of rework.
